context:
Goal: a triage session on your Mac or PC pushes its roadmap with no override from you.
Problem (goal): the guard roadmap-one-writer (one writer for the roadmap branch) reads a session's tier only from its cloud tags. A Mac session has no tags, and this app gives no tool to add them. So home triage asks you for override on each push (your chat, 15:43 CST).
Based on (ruling): item 213, local-triage-tier-word (owner, 2026-11-05 07:44 CST): no tier word, not cloud-only, a tier file only if it works on Mac and Windows, until then build nothing.
Based on (read): debt local-triage-tier-proof on main, retire line: a guard test on both platforms.
Departs from: main, where the guard reads cloud tags only — adds a tier file that the guard also reads, on Mac and Windows.
Meanwhile: nothing builds. Home triage needs override 15m for its pushes.
holds: Whether to build the local tier proof now.

options.gain: Home triage on your Mac pushes with no override from you.
options.how: A claude-settings lane builds the tier file: the coordinator writes it when it starts a triage session, and the guard reads it, on Mac and Windows. Tests show the push refused before and passed after, on both.
options.label: Build it now
options.lose: One lane of build and review.

options.how: Nothing changes. Each refused push waits for your typed override.
options.label: Keep the debt
options.lose: You type override for home triage's pushes, as today.

reply: You picked a in chat at 15:45 CST Nov 6: build it now and merge it fast. Home: step local-triage-tier-build (PR #1378) and debt local-triage-tier-proof. Closed 12:12 CST Nov 7.
short: Mac triage: build the tier file now
